race.comment: KA YING RISING (1) champion Hong Kong sprinter who meets a similar line up after winning this race last year with ridiculous ease. Demolished a small field by 7 lens first-up in a weaker race over 1200m in the G3 HKSAR Chief Executive's Cup at Sha Tin. Looks too strong again. TEMPTED (9) outstanding sprinting mare undefeated since finishing runner up in this race last year. Has gone to a new level this time in and worth noting she started from the rails draw last year. Conditions suit and look for her late. JIMMYSSTAR (2) ran third here last year and looks to be back on track after his classy victory over 1200m in the G1 Manikato Stakes at Caulfield. Can stalk the good tempo and figure prominently. JOLIESTAR (8) classy mare who resumed over the unsuitable 1100m with a closing second in the G2 The Shorts at this track. Since kept up to the mark with a 1000m trial at this course. J Mac sticks and keep safe. NINJA (7) can place and defeated KA YING RISING in a recent trial.
